title: Who-can Finder & Least-Privilege Wizard for Workspace Rollouts
creator: Amina Cortez
description:
Problem: Admins need quick answers for questions like "who can delete model snapshots in Workspace A?" or "which roles allow deployment to Dedicated pools?" Current audit and role pages are siloed: role lists, raw audit rows, and policy JSON live in separate surfaces, which slows incident response and safe rollouts.

Goal: Design an integrated "Who-can Finder" that surfaces answers to concrete questions across org/workspace boundaries and an accompanying "Least-Privilege Wizard" that helps create scoped temporary roles or suggested role edits for safe rollouts. The UX should be compact (fits in the Console right rail or modal), friendly to non-admins (clear language), and produce reproducible audit links and rollout tasks.

Scope: UI/UX for Console (workspace + org contexts), prototypes for both desktop and narrow screens, copy for explainers and microcopy for audit links and justification fields. Engineering integration points documented for API needs, sample queries, and telemetry events.
acceptance_criteria: A compact Who-can Finder prototype answers at least 10 common admin questions with one click and shows the list of principals (users/groups/roles) with context (workspace, last-used timestamp, source of permission).

The Least-Privilege Wizard produces a recommended role patch or a temporary scoped role template that PM/Eng can preview and export as JSON and triggers a rollout task in Console (mock action in prototype).
Audit links are generated per result row and open the audit viewer filtered to the relevant actions and time window.
Design is reviewed with Security and Privacy; privacy impact and KMS/audit considerations captured in comments.
Responsiveness: right-rail card works down to 900px width; modal version covers mobile flows for reviewers.
Accessibility: keyboard navigable, contrast passes AA, and screen reader labels for principal rows and action buttons.
tasks: Run research: interview 6 platform admins about common 'who can' questions (Amina) - done
Create low-fidelity flows for right-rail card and full modal (Jonah) - done
High-fidelity Figma screens: results table, principal detail flyout, role suggestion editor (design) - in review
Convene engineering review to map needed APIs: permission graph endpoint, recent-activity query, role patch apply endpoint (SRE/Platform) - scheduled
Copy review with Legal/Security for audit link language and data retention hints - pending
Prototype test with 3 internal admins and 2 security engineers; collect feedback - planned
decisions: Expose Who-can Finder as a right-rail contextual card on resource pages (models, routes, Dedicated pools) and as a full modal from Settings > Access.
Show aggregated principals with role provenance instead of raw policy statements to reduce noise (engineering will provide a summarized path via permission graph).

Least-Privilege Wizard will offer two outputs: (1) suggested role edits (inline diff) and (2) a temporary scoped role template with TTL. We will not autosave or apply changes without explicit confirmation.
Audit links will surface a 7-day default window with quick presets (24h, 7d, 30d) and include anchors to the specific audit event when available.
Telemetry event names agreed: whocan.query, whocan.open_principal, whocan.create_template, whocan.apply_patch (apply_patch gated behind backend feature flag).
